verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for an equity-management SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows bulk, user-triggered workflow automation (granting, documents, signatures), HRIS data syncs, automated error flags, and API service accounts with delta queries. None of these documents user-configurable automations that run autonomously on a schedule or trigger. Bulk one-off actions are not recurring background jobs, and the API is a developer building block, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
